# phenix logs

<!-- Generated by `make cli-docs` from the phenix command tree. Do not edit. -->

Every command on this page also accepts the [global flags](index.md#options).

## phenix logs

Show the log entries of the phenix server

### Synopsis

```text
Show the log entries of the phenix server

  Prints the entries of the phenix ui server's system log in a time range,
  oldest first, one on each line, as the Logs page does: by default those of
  the last hour. The server reads its log files, so the command calls it
  over its unix socket (--unix-socket). -o json and -o yaml print the
  entries with the fields of GET /logs. phenix logs files and phenix logs
  download get the whole phenix and minimega log files.
```

```text
phenix logs [flags]
```

### Examples

```text
# The entries of the last 10 minutes
phenix logs --since 10m

# The entries of a time range
phenix logs --start 2026-11-06T08:00:00Z --end 2026-11-06T09:00:00Z
```

### Options

```text
      --end string       last time to show, in RFC 3339 format (default: 30 seconds after now)
  -h, --help             help for logs
  -o, --output string    Output format (table, json, yaml) (default "table")
      --since duration   show the entries of this time before now (default 1h0m0s)
      --start string     first time to show, in RFC 3339 format (default: --since before now)
```

## phenix logs download

Write a log file of the phenix server to stdout or to a local file

```text
phenix logs download <phenix|minimega> [flags]
```

### Examples

```text
phenix logs download minimega -O minimega.log
```

### Options

```text
  -h, --help                 help for download
  -O, --output-file string   write the log file to this path instead of stdout
```

### SEE ALSO

* [phenix logs](logs.md) - Show the log entries of the phenix server

## phenix logs files

Display a table of the log files to download

### Synopsis

```text
Display a table of the log files to download

  Shows the phenix system log (log.system.path) and the minimega log
  (ui.logs.minimega-path) of the phenix ui server, and whether the server can
  read each of them now, or why not. -o json and -o yaml print the files
  with the fields of GET /logs/files.
```

```text
phenix logs files [flags]
```

### Options

```text
  -h, --help            help for files
  -o, --output string   Output format (table, json, yaml) (default "table")
```

### SEE ALSO

* [phenix logs](logs.md) - Show the log entries of the phenix server
